items.hed: Texans are on the road Sunday at Tennessee, noon Central
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule lists Sunday, Oct. 4, as a home game against Dallas at Reliant Stadium, noon Central on FOX. It does not print a final score. Next is Sunday, Oct. 11, at the Titans in Nashville, noon Central, on CBS. The London game at Jacksonville is Oct. 18, 8:30 a.m. Central, on NFL Network.

items.hed: Astros open the offseason hunting a general manager, with Espada’s status still open
items.insight: MLB.com reports the Astros were swept by the White Sox in the American League Wild Card Series, 7-3 in the last game, after an 81-81 season that still won the AL West. Joe Espada, in the last year of his contract, said he would like to return. The club is searching for a general manager. No new manager decision is posted.

items.hed: Rockets open the preseason Friday against Dallas in Macao
items.insight: NBA.com’s 2026-27 key dates, updated Oct. 6, list Oct. 9 as an NBA China Games preseason date: Dallas against Houston at The Venetian Arena in Macao, with a second game there Oct. 11. Rosters for opening day are set Oct. 19 at 5 p.m. Eastern. The regular season starts Oct. 20.
